finding: Epoch-only provider-admission provenance is insufficient to identify an exact policy decision when canonical admission content can change within one authority epoch. counterhypothesis: Freezing a previously validated admission snapshot would improve reproducibility but could let a previously FREE provider continue after revocation. The binding therefore never acts as authority and never replaces the live canonical admission read.
